scientific_integrity: Exact symbolic characteristic matrix, Hurwitz minors, and rational Sturm root counts were replayed; independent scientific validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only transverse local orbital stability of two explicit zero-mean three-node rotating states is proved; global basins, all other states, and nonlinear endpoint bifurcations are not classified.
title: A sharp attracting-triangle window in a heterogeneous Stuart–Landau network
